exchanges: arrived in brisbane and its 30 degrees in october what is this
Spring here is warm. You will adjust.
my housemate bridget picked me up from the airport which was so kind
Lovely start. Had you met her before?
only online. shes a nurse and does night shifts so we'll barely see each other
That can make sharing a house easy.
the job at Coldlink starts next week, its all refrigerated freight
Cold chain is a growing field. What will you be doing?
inventory controller, so i count frozen stuff in a freezer basically lol
Bring a good jacket.
my team lead noor did the zoom interview, shes leaving for Perth in a few months tho
Shame to lose her so soon.
which is funny bc my best mate is also called noor
That will get confusing in conversation.
she just got a job teaching english and is moving to Seoul
That is a big adventure for her.
so proud of her
She sounds brave.
callum from work is obsessed with the Wallabies, he made me watch highlights at lunch
You might get pulled into watching games then.
i dont get rugby union at all lol. i only follow the Broncos bc my dad did
Family teams stick with you.
got a physio appointment on Thursday for my knee, old surfing injury
Good to get it checked early.
cant wait to get back in the water here once its fixed
There are great beaches not far from the city.
my sister hana is pregnant!! due in August
Congratulations, that is wonderful news.
auntie! and ill be so far away
You can still visit, and video calls help.
bridget made pavlova for my welcome and says its her favourite thing ever
That is a sweet welcome.
i couldnt have the pie she made the night before tho, i cant eat mushrooms at all
Good to tell her early so she can plan.
my cousin amaru texted, hes back in Cusco visiting where he grew up
That sounds like a nice trip home.
i finally started Succession, everyone told me to
It is very good once it gets going.
the characters are all awful lol
That is part of the fun.
oh amaru corrected me lol, he grew up in Arequipa, cusco is just where his grandparents are
Easy mix-up.
the possums on the roof are so loud at night
Possums are noisy neighbours.
bridget says they live in the gum tree out the back
Then they are not going anywhere soon.
hang on where's my best mate moving to again
bridget plays ukulele on her days off and its honestly kind of nice
That is a cheerful sound to have around the house.
ok dinner time, im starving
Enjoy your dinner.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your best mate Noor is moving to Seoul.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your best mate Noor is moving to Perth.
